limitations: Top news sites are selected from comScore’s Top 100 digital news properties; reported site numbers cover desktop and mobile only.
The report notes that “Mixed Reality” is defined inconsistently by technology and media companies, and is sometimes used to describe VR.
AR-optimized smartphones are defined as phones with 6DoF tracking enabled by SLAM, which requires carefully calibrated hardware and software.
The AR enterprise-market examples cover three major early applications; the report notes that other industries may also be affected.
For the YouTube creator analysis, each YouTube channel is treated as a unique creator.
